accelerometer_odr.docs:
**string**: The output data rate of the accelerometer. One of `OFF`, `12_5HZ`, `26HZ`, `52HZ`, `104HZ`, `208HZ`, `416HZ`, `833HZ`, `1666HZ`, `3332HZ`, `6664HZ`. Defaults to `104HZ`.

*See also: [LSM6DS Accelerometer/Gyroscope Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/motion/lsm6ds#configuration-variables)*

accelerometer_range.docs:
**string**: The full-scale range of the accelerometer. One of `2G`, `4G`, `8G`, `16G`. Defaults to `4G`.

*See also: [LSM6DS Accelerometer/Gyroscope Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/motion/lsm6ds#configuration-variables)*

address.docs:
**int**: Manually specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x6A`, on some boards it may need to be set to `0x6B`.

*See also: [LSM6DS Accelerometer/Gyroscope Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/motion/lsm6ds#configuration-variables)*

gyroscope_odr.docs:
**string**: The output data rate of the gyroscope. One of `OFF`, `12_5HZ`, `26HZ`, `52HZ`, `104HZ`, `208HZ`, `416HZ`, `833HZ`, `1666HZ`, `3332HZ`, `6664HZ`. Defaults to `208HZ`.

*See also: [LSM6DS Accelerometer/Gyroscope Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/motion/lsm6ds#configuration-variables)*

gyroscope_range.docs:
**string**: The full-scale range of the gyroscope. One of `125DPS`, `250DPS`, `500DPS`, `1000DPS`, `2000DPS`. Defaults to `2000DPS`.

*See also: [LSM6DS Accelerometer/Gyroscope Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/motion/lsm6ds#configuration-variables)*

type.docs:
**string**: Must be set to `temperature`, or simply omitted.

*See also: [LSM6DS Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/lsm6ds#configuration-variables)*
